name: Quasi Quest
source:
The first installment of QUASI QUEST, which is a spinoff of Quasi Cake, where the characters are thrust into a fantasy setting.

This edition features the quest of ZERO, as he goes off in search of a magical item that can give him bishie sparkles.

[From [url=http://applepai.deviantart.com/art/QUASI-QUEST-SFS-251588048]DeviantArt[/url]]
translation:
《Quasi Quest》的第一部作品。这是《Quasi Cake》的衍生系列，将原作角色带入了奇幻背景。

这一篇讲述零的冒险：他踏上旅途，寻找一件能让自己拥有美少年闪光特效的魔法物品。

（摘自[url=http://applepai.deviantart.com/art/QUASI-QUEST-SFS-251588048]DeviantArt[/url]）
